t: How to Get Weed Out of Your System | Zinnia Health
s: September 13, 2024 - Home Remedies: Several home remedies also promise to get your body ultra clean, like drinking cranberry juice, taking a tablespoon of lemon juice, downing apple cider vinegar, or loading up on vitamin C. These recommendations likely sprout from the fact that these substances contain antioxidants, but there’s no evidence showing they will help you detoxify your body of weed or any other substance. Exercise and Fasting: A study showed that physical exercise and fasting from food did not help release more cannabinoids from the fat cells of daily cannabis users and also does not risk more detectable levels in urine and blood tests. Professional and medically supervised detox programs do exist that can help you clean THC out of your system, but it’s not possible to achieve a one-day detox or even a seven-day detox.
